main_issue: Who should clean the shellfish-contaminated shared pan now so D can cook, plus a forward rule to wash pans after use

A-B.evidence: Both deny using the pan and refuse to clean it (T4, T9, T12, T15, T17); B accepts A's rule 'Fine' (T8), but neither will clean the pan now.

A-C.evidence: C says 'We all live here' (T13) and pushes shared responsibility; A repeats 'it's not my mess to clean up' (T15, T17). A's rule (T7) goes unanswered by C.

A-D.evidence: D says 'I can't cook until someone cleans that pan' (T14); A responds with 'why is it my job' (T15) and refuses, leaving D's need unmet.

B-C.evidence: C challenges B: 'you're just leaving it for the rest of us?' (T11), 'We all live here' (T13); B replies 'It's not my pan' (T12) and goes to bed.

B-D.evidence: D says the pan must be cleaned (T14); B says 'that doesn't make the pan clean' (T16) but won't clean it, citing sleep and work (T12).

C-D.evidence: C acknowledges 'Agent D needs to cook' (T5) and pushes others to take responsibility; D agrees 'Yes, I do' (T6) and wants it cleaned (T14).
